Those top sellers on Etsy have some things in common 👀 I’ve been selling on Etsy for 6 years and I’ll be honest with you, there isn’t a magic formula. Anyone who tells you otherwise, is probably trying to sell you something. BUT!! there are things I see top Etsy sellers do over and over again that I believe 100% helps them make more sales: 1) They use DATA. This is a big one that so many new sellers overlook. Top sellers aren’t just randomly deciding what niche they want to sell in or what phrase to put on their shirt. They use tools like Everbee, erank, or RankHero to find profitable niches BEFORE they put a single product in their Etsy shop. They also use these tools to optimize their titles, tags, and general SEO. Stop guessing, start using DATA 🙌 2) They study design trends. Top sellers have their finger on the pulse of what is currently trending. They use Pinterest, other Etsy shops, trends reports, and just in general their eyes and minds when they are out shopping to start noticing patterns of what is currently trending and then they apply those trends to their designs! 🥳 3) They use Print on Demand. Not all of them, but most of the top shops I see are using Printify as their supplier so that they can sell more products! 🙌 When you can test out different designs and styles and products without the upfront costs, you are giving yourself so many more chances to be found by your target audience. Print on demand is a game changer for Etsy sellers and I talk a LOT about how you can use Printify in your Etsy shop! 💖 4) Their mockups are on POINT. This is something I will never stop shouting from the rooftops because it is THAT important. Good mockups can make or break your Etsy shop - get some good ones!! 5) They don’t give up!! They test and test and test and take any data and information they get and apply it to more designs, more products, and that eventually leads to more sales. Keep learning, keep growing, and don’t give up because YOU CAN DO THIS!! And if you have any questions I’m always here to help!! 💖💖 #etsyseller #etsytips #printondemand #etsytipsandtricks #etsyforbeginners Etsy tips for beginners. Start Etsy in 2026. Etsy sellers are closing their shops, and this should be a wake-up call for every small business owner. Etsy’s controversial new AI policy would allow the platform and certain third-party partners to use seller content for AI development and training. After backlash from longtime sellers, Etsy says it plans to revise the terms. Here’s the bigger issue: When you build your entire business on someone else’s platform, you’re playing by their rules. That’s why NOW is the time to invest in your own e-commerce website. Own your brand. Build direct relationships with your customers. Control your storefront. Stop relying entirely on marketplaces that can change their policies overnight. I’m not saying abandon Etsy. I’m saying use marketplaces to grow your business, but build a website to protect its future.
